title: Admin console — user management (Keyline Admin)
notes: v1 is a Bootstrap 4 admin template (icon-font nav, users <table>, Bootstrap modal). v2 is a Tailwind UI app shell: the sidebar is regrouped ('Audit log' moves to the top of a new 'Security & compliance' group) and duplicated in a hidden mobile off-canvas drawer; 'Users' becomes 'Members'; the user table becomes a card grid sorted by name with sr-only 'Open options' kebab buttons; status tabs become links in a new order; 'Invite user' becomes a split button 'Invite member' (its menu contains 'Invite users via CSV') with a hidden sticky-header copy; the modal becomes a Headless UI dialog with React ids, Team/Role swapped and a hidden CSV tab that repeats the role select and 'Send invite'. The notification bell is a web component with a declarative shadow root.
